detail: The patch.mjs in-model patch method rewrites matvec reduction kernels (PLAN ids 99/105/112/113) via K-split anchors. Shader 0119 is an elementwise fake-quant kernel (clamp/quantize/round/dequantize, 1546 bytes, no workgroup memory, no reduction loop), so none of the rewrite anchors apply and www/patch.html fails closed on unlisted ids (missed-check throws). A real 0119 fusion test needs a newly designed WGSL fusion plus token-diff correctness gating, which is kernel development, not a measurement.
